written.headline: IEA projects global data center investment to reach $4T by 2030
written.summary: The International Energy Agency reported that global data center investments are expected to reach $4 trillion by 2030. The report also noted that fewer than 100 major AI projects would require a combined 50 gigawatts of power.

written.headline: Early Anthropic investor Dustin Moskovitz says labs should slow down
written.summary: Anthropic's early investor Dustin Moskovitz stated that he invested to promote safety rather than racing and that frontier AI labs should slow down. His stake from a 2021 investment is expected to be worth billions as Anthropic completes its public debut.

written.headline: Canva adds toggle to disable generative AI features for all users
written.summary: Canva introduced a setting that lets free and paid users turn off most of its generative AI tools, including Magic Expand and AI image generation, while keeping non‑generative tools like background remover on.

written.headline: Karnataka hosts 1,088 GCCs and 111,000 AI/ML professionals, new report finds
written.summary: A Zinnov-KDEM report released at the Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026 found Karnataka hosts 1,088 global capability centres (51% of India's total) and 111,000 AI/ML professionals, with over 120 dedicated AI/ML Centres of Excellence.
